anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: T701 reads 340.0 °C versus T702 70.513 °C and T712 52.353 °C; the large reboiler-to-column discrepancy persists throughout the record and requires validation.
Before the transient, PDI702 was 2.004 mbar and distillate flow was 0.423 L/h.
PDI702 rose to 3.703 mbar and distillate flow to 0.658 L/h while T702 fell to 71.428 °C.
Pressure difference partially recovered to 2.244 mbar and distillate flow to 0.501 L/h, but T702, T704 and T706 continued falling to 70.513, 65.981 and 66.070 °C respectively.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol setpoints and commanded changes are needed to interpret the hydraulic transient; independently verify T701 temperature and tag calibration to distinguish actual overheating from a measurement fault. No composition measurement or separation acceptance criterion has been supplied.
